CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cp7_credit.consumer_native_invariant_v1(p_sale uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
declare native jsonb;events jsonb;journals jsonb;
begin
 native:=cp7_credit.source_native_snapshot_v1(p_sale);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(v order by v->>'id'collate"C"),'[]')into events
  from jsonb_array_elements(native->'base_events')v where not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events ce
   where ce.event_kind='APPLY'and ce.target_sale_id=p_sale and ce.journal_id=substring(v->>'id'from 9)::uuid);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(v order by v->>'id'collate"C"),'[]')into journals
  from jsonb_array_elements(native->'journals')v where not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events ce
   where ce.event_kind='APPLY'and ce.target_sale_id=p_sale and ce.journal_id=(v->>'id')::uuid);
 -- The opaque support hash contains ALLOCATION.sale including the very
 -- status/version/touch fields retired by this command. Raw allocations,
 -- items, movements, lots, HPP versions/caches/GL/targets remain exact here.
 -- The qualified source terminal proof makes the same distinction.
 return (native-'hpp_support')||jsonb_build_object('sale',(native->'sale')-'status'-'row_version'-'updated_at',
  'base_events',events,'journals',journals);
end $function$

 SET search_path TO ''

AS $function$
 with lots as(select l.*from erp.fg_lots l where l.id=any(cp7_credit.source_hpp_lot_ids_v1(p_sale)))
 select cp7_credit.source_document_snapshot_v1(p_sale)||jsonb_build_object(
  'fg_lots',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l)order by l.id),'[]')from lots l),
  'hpp_versions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(h)order by h.id),'[]')from erp.hpp_versions h where h.lot_id in(select id from lots)),
  'stock_movements',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m)order by m.id),'[]')from erp.fg_stock_movements m where m.lot_id in(select id from lots)),
  'inventory_balances',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b)order by b.product_id,b.location_id,b.quality_grade),'[]')
   from erp.fg_inventory_balances b where b.product_id in(select product_id from lots)),
  'opening_hpp_states',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)order by s.lot_id),'[]')from erp.opening_lot_hpp_gl_state s where s.lot_id in(select id from lots)),
  'opening_hpp_corrections',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)order by c.id),'[]')from erp.opening_hpp_corrections c where c.lot_id in(select id from lots)),
  'po_hpp_states',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)order by s.po_id),'[]')from erp.po_hpp_gl_state s where s.po_id in(select po_id from lots)),
  'nonpo_hpp_events',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)order by e.id),'[]')from erp.non_po_hpp_gl_sync_events_v2620f e where e.product_id in(select product_id from lots)),
  'po_hpp_events',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)order by e.id),'[]')from erp.po_hpp_gl_events e where e.po_id in(select po_id from lots)),
  'hpp_journals',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'status',j.status,
    'immutable_payload',cp7_credit.materialized_journal_payload(j.id))order by j.id),'[]')from erp.journal_entries j where j.id in(
     select l.journal_entry_id from erp.journal_lines l where l.product_id in(select product_id from lots)or l.po_id in(select po_id from lots))),
  'hpp_balances',cp7_credit.source_hpp_balances_v1(p_sale),
  'hpp_accounts',cp7_credit.initial_hpp_account_facts_v1(),
  'period_snapshot',(select to_jsonb(p)from erp.accounting_period_control p where singleton_id=1),
  'hpp_support',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('product_id',x.product_id,'po_id',x.po_id,
   'facts',cp7_credit.initial_hpp_support_v1(x.product_id,x.po_id))order by x.product_id,x.po_id),'[]')from(
    select distinct i.product_id,l.po_id from erp.sale_stock_allocations a join erp.sales_items i on i.id=a.sale_item_id
    join erp.fg_lots l on l.id=a.lot_id where i.sale_id=p_sale)x))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp._cp7_current_credit_adjustment(p_sale uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
declare h erp.sales_headers;m record;i numeric;u numeric;
begin
 select *into strict h from erp.sales_headers where id=p_sale;
 -- Preserve inactive/DRAFT document financial semantics: own Native P only.
 if h.status not in('POSTED','PARTIAL_PAID','PAID')then return 0::numeric;end if;
 select *into strict m from cp7_credit.current_leaf_assignment(p_sale);
 -- Legacy invoices/ordinary returns have no OW04 participation. Preserve the
 -- Native payment projection without inventing family order or requiring a
 -- retrofit of old posted returns. A protected journal cannot exploit this
 -- fast path: every such actual journal must have its exact retained link.
 if exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j
  where j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_RECOGNITION'and not exists(
   select 1 from cp7_credit.component_journals cj
    join cp7_credit.component_parts q on q.id=cj.part_id
    join cp7_credit.recognition_components cc on cc.id=q.component_id
    join cp7_credit.recognition_plans p on p.id=cc.plan_id
    join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=p.cohort_id
    join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id
   where cj.journal_id=j.id and q.id=j.source_id))
  or exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j
   where j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_REFUND'and not exists(
    select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
     join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=e.cohort_id
     join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id
    where e.journal_id=j.id and e.id=j.source_id and e.event_kind='REFUND'))
  or exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j where j.source_type in('CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_APPLY','CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_EVENT_REVERSE')
   and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events ce join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=ce.cohort_id
    join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id where ce.journal_id=j.id and ce.id=j.source_id
     and((j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_APPLY'and ce.event_kind='APPLY'and ce.amount>0 and ce.restores_event_id is null)
      or(j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_EVENT_REVERSE'and ce.amount<0 and ce.restores_event_id is not null))))then
  raise exception 'CP7_CREDIT_UNREPRESENTED_FINANCIAL_JOURNAL';end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.return_families f where f.family_root_sale_id=m.root_sale_id)
  and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
   where e.event_kind='APPLY'and e.target_sale_id=p_sale)then return 0::numeric;end if;
 if cp7_credit.payment_is_intermediate_v1(p_sale)then return cp7_credit.payment_intermediate_adjustment_v1(p_sale);end if;
 perform cp7_credit.assert_current_materialized_profile(p_sale,m.root_sale_id,m.current_leaf_id);
 -- Validator above proves ALL parts have actual journals; this join is not a
 -- silent filter permitting a partial pending plan to masquerade as actual I.
 select coalesce(sum(q.amount),0)into i
  from cp7_credit.return_families f join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.family_id=f.id
  join cp7_credit.recognition_plans p on p.cohort_id=c.id
  join cp7_credit.recognition_components cc on cc.plan_id=p.id
  join cp7_credit.component_parts q on q.component_id=cc.id
  join cp7_credit.component_journals j on j.part_id=q.id
  where f.family_root_sale_id=m.root_sale_id;
 -- Signed restores are retained, not filtered away by amount/status. An
 -- advance-backed Native sales_payment is already P and is NOT another U.
 select coalesce(sum(e.amount),0)into u from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
  where e.event_kind='APPLY'and e.target_sale_id=p_sale;
 return u-i;
end $function$
